capabilities: Run CodeM, Doubao CLI and Claude Code in parallel tabs
Stream replies with live thinking and tool-call cards
Browse, archive and roll back session history
Insert skills and @note or @folder references into prompts
Queue prompts and switch permission levels
extras: Requires Windows 10/11 and Obsidian 1.7.2+; runs locally with no telemetry and reads session history from ~/.codem/sessions, ~/.claude/projects and ~/.claude/archives.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to talk to AI coding agents, so using them means leaving the vault for a terminal.

relations.evidence: run CodeM (Feishu AI coding agent), Doubao CLI and Claude Code side by side in one sidebar chat
Doubao CLI backend: per-turn -p invocation with --resume session continuity
Claude Code backend: stream-json true streaming with live thinking
布局与交互设计参考 Claudian（Obsidian AI 对话插件）

summary: Sidebar chat that runs CodeM, Doubao CLI and Claude Code agents in parallel tabs, with the vault as their working directory.
